claim: Identity, scope, abstract and historical programme
detail: Planting newly accreted coastal land outside embankments; prior mangrove loss not established. Disaster protection goals are not measured effects. Abstract suitability areas disagree with results.

claim: Table 1: five criteria, fifteen class positions and complete weights
detail: hossain_tables.json retains all weights/classes/scores/dashes. Soil texture, tidal area, pH, salinity and land use are genuinely used, not just mentioned. Native grass cutting is explicit; no admission before practice ruling.

claim: Classification methods and spatial outputs, Figures 1–2
detail: Landsat 1999/30m, maps, field plots, supervised classification and local output map; not independent survival validation. Silty clay/soil series context and newly accreted grassed mudflats preserved.

claim: Natural grasses and planting sequence, Figures 3 and 5
detail: Oryza coarctata, Myrostachya wightiana, Suaeda nudiflora indicate stability; cutting grass rows for planting described. These are not mangrove species envelopes; no native-habitat conversion authorised.

Elevation 0–1m is observed distribution with no stated datum, not calibrated limits. A=4h, B=8h, C=12h and A preferred; depth and duration jointly vary and denominator not explicit. No percent-time conversion.

Avicennia and Sonneratia planted; coastal water 30–35‰ and 20‰ May–September are context not salinity envelope. A. officinalis 20–25m and A. alba/A. marina 10–15m heights; Rhizophora 1–2m at 20 years. Sonneratia high-accretion selection retained as species-specific qualitative pointer, no rate calibration.

May–September collection; nursery then calm-weather planting, three-year maintenance attributed to Chowdhury 1998. 10% first versus 80–90% second seedling wording ambiguous; 1–2ft first-year/5–6ft third-year growth not T4. Silt/waves and conversion losses are asset-risk pointers, not new units in this lane.

claim: Table 2, conclusion, sea-level discussion and references
detail: All twelve monthly highest/lowest values retained; personal communication, datum unknown. Protection explicitly unquantified. Slow/fast sea-level adjustment cites Hogarth 1999; no independent threshold or effect extracted.

Restoration comparison in impaired mangroves, not afforestation. Hydroperiod has level/frequency/duration; hours/month is duration, not frequency. Introduction stress statements cite other works; no new independent vote over Lewis/Van Loon already reviewed.

claim: Study area, Figure 1 and hydrological intervention
detail: Zone I 19ha versus Zone II 75.5ha; non-random treatments differ in timing/area. Climate 34°C,1680mm; tidal amplitude .43m, seasonal -.24/.92m; lagoon salinity18–36; N .71%,P .047%,OM16–30%,bulk density .29g/cm3 are site descriptions. No T4 ranges. Native scientific names retained without common-name correction.

DGPS referenced point .446masl WGS84, TNT Mips watershed routing locates channels. Generic terrain-use is intervention design, not suitability response. Figure range -.631 to .037m is terrain extrema; text prints 0037. Channel dimensions retained in perez_values.json, not engineering recommendations.

claim: Monitoring, Fourier equations, regression and tests
detail: Hourly loggers below soil; porewater sampling35cm; reference-site comparison. Rainfall was tested, not established as suitability determinant. Fig4 x-axis reference/y-axis sites appears opposite to response/explanatory wording on p7; retain discrepancy for any model reuse. Algebra not ported or validated.

Nine panels: three years × frequency(days/month), duration(hours/month), level(m), five sites each. No class/tolerance boundaries. 2012 called prior in results but during elsewhere; not clean pre-treatment baseline. Box quantiles require data or explicit digitisation before numeric extraction.

Twelve panels: sites1–4 × 2012/2013/2014. Regression coefficients and significance are associations, not suitability functions. No increasing-duration suitability direction from positive site-reference correlation.

Three annual panels each for site1/reference. Native figure5 labels43/20/9days (2012),74/37/16 (2013),74/27/15 (2014); figure6 labels43/20/9,76/38/16,153/28/14. Narrative uses partly different cycles; do not silently harmonise. Spectrum amplitudes not suitability values.

Two transects/different intervention windows. All reported means in perez_values.json. Captions say during versus after, while prose sometimes says before. Salinity scale not EC; source figure has no unit label. No freshwater/flooding blanket direction.

Restored circles, undisturbed reference cross, impaired triangle, conserved Florida squares from reference59 are distinct lineages. Max/min flooding group comparisons, not mangrove thresholds. 58–76mg/L impaired max;13.6 impaired min and15.6 reference min are observations.

Additional channel at site1 increased drainage at site2 and A. germinans mortality, citing Echeverria-Avila2019. Subsidence and longer flooding supported R. mangle colonisation. Not monotonic drainage or elevation response; species identity retained.

claim: Costs, sulfide assertion, regeneration and conclusions
detail: Costs $10000/ha versus$5300/ha belong T6E extraction later. Cited planting costs and long-term >50yr survival guarantee are not measured here. Sulfide34mg/L assertion mixes mangrove/saltmarsh references64–66 and lacks canonical mapping. Biological community not fully recovered; dwarf/stressed forests remain. References to biomass/fauna outcomes point to companion studies.

claim: Supporting Table S1, references, raw-data links
detail: S1 DOCX predictor coefficients not acquired or rendered; once-render rule required. Nine Figshare links in p2 are seed pointers only, dataset intake paused. References retained for primary recovery; no DOI/citation promotion from bibliography alone.

claim: Repository cover, URL-only page and article identity
detail: 14PDF pages = two repository pages plus12article pages. Article title/DOI matches acquisition. Abstract reports modelled coverage tradeoffs, not observed restoration success.

Problem:~1000ha from23000degraded; objectives ecology/services/community; actions hydrological; constraints local drivers only; ROOT optimisation. Planting prerequisite cites Perez2020/Teutli2021. Historical law/extraction permits are source context, not legal guidance or hard masks.

Four degradation classes, temporal dataset fusion, four broad drivers plus invasive vine map. 190 units assigned production driver by consensus. Native time mismatch/4000ha tidal-scale attribution may overestimate. All five ecological, five economic objectives and three community metrics inventoried. No new soil/climate rules.

claim: Nearby healthy mangroves and migration buffers
detail: Both use2km but different rationales. Propagule reference Sengupta2005 is Rhizophora mangle in Florida; do not imply universal2km cutoff. Migration reference >1km Florida is not2km calibration. Healthy-area radius is not distance-to-source measurement.

Maximum water extent across37years is not permanent inundation or tidal duration. Land categories for migration potential do not authorise habitat conversion. Fish/tourism/agriculture/aquaculture/grazing potential is competing use/planning, not measured restoration outcomes.

claim: ROOT problem, units, weights and constraints
detail: 468units; nominal500ha hexagons, irregular minimum40ha; budget~1000ha. Three scenarios, equal active-objective weights; community overlay after ROOT, not part of objective vector. Source ranks/weights not runtime MCDA defaults.

villarreal_metrics.json preserves min/max objectives and3values per row. Percent of maximum value not success probability. Ecological1232ha/19sites,social1034ha/2sites,combined1230ha/14sites. Local relative comparison, no measured intervention performance.

Governance EV ev_mr_governance_villarreal24_20261028. Land-access/communal approval EV ev_mr_landaccess_villarreal24_20261028. Combined/ecological low-organisation95%/80%,unauthorized activities76%/58%,prior engagement88%/48%; social all1034ha in one low-organisation ejido. Not probabilities or score weights. Boundary gaps74ha/6% and50ha/4% reflect mapping mismatch; no inference of insecure tenure.

Final intervention~10ha from stakeholder choices; size constraint biases toward small units. Large~2000ha works exceed present institutional capacity, not inherently impossible. Six-month analysis plus four-month reporting; static metrics, no explicit uncertainty or SLR model. Sediment-supply/dam scenario means migration space alone insufficient; no current dam-status claim.

Appendices S1–S6 unacquired. S2 standards,S4 community methods,S5 optimisation crucial for reuse. ROOT code/project and2022 final report followups, not newly acquired or registered. Existing Lewis/Perez/Teutli records reused as named pointers; no duplicate citations registered.
